welcome.tagline: Your identity, held by you and presented when you decide to.
welcome.createHint: A phrase only you hold, and an identity only you can use
welcome.signInHint: Bring an identity back from the words you wrote down

intro.other: These {count} words are the identity. Write them down, in this order, and keep them somewhere only you reach.

phrase.warning: Nobody can give them back to you. Whoever has them has the identity, and losing them loses it.

acknowledge.other: I have written the {count} words down and I have them with me

phrase.restarted: That was not the word asked for. These are new words: the old ones are gone, so write these down before going on.

confirm.title: Check what you wrote
confirm.intro: Pick the word that goes in each position, reading from the copy you keep.
confirm.question: Which word is number {position}?

warning.other: One wrong answer starts the whole thing again, with {count} new words to write down.

restore.title: Your phrase
restore.intro: Write your phrase in the order you wrote it down. Twelve words or twenty-four, whichever you have — and in whichever language you made it.

errors.identity_entropy_unavailable: This device would not supply the randomness a phrase is made from. Nothing has been created.
errors.identity_word_count: A phrase has twelve words or twenty-four.
errors.identity_checksum: Those words are not a phrase this wallet ever produced. Check the spelling and the order.
errors.identity_no_draft: There was no phrase to confirm. Start again.
errors.identity_unknown: The identity could not be made. Try again.

protect.title: Choose a PIN
protect.intro: The identity is written down on this device now, encrypted, and these digits are what open it. There is nothing that can reset them: forgetting the PIN means starting again from your phrase.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.emptyHint: Credentials issued to you will show up here.

identity.title: Identity
identity.codeLabel: Your identifier as a QR code

scan.title: Scan QR
scan.instruction: Line the QR code up inside the frame
scan.hint: Hold the device steady until the code is read

permission.deniedBody: Turn the camera back on for the wallet in the system settings, then come back to this screen.

error.title: The camera could not be started

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.hint: What this device lets the wallet do

development.title: Development
development.hint: What this build is, and what it can do here

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.unenrolled: Nothing set up on this device
permissions.deniedHint: It was turned off for the wallet. Only the system settings can turn it back on.

logs.title: Log
logs.notBrowsable: On Android the log stays in this application's private storage, where no file explorer reaches it. Share it or save a copy to get it out.

exportHeader.what: Almena ID wallet log, exported on {when}.
exportHeader.safe: It holds no recovery phrase, no seed, no PIN and no key. The wallet never writes those down.
exportHeader.cost: It does hold when this wallet was used, which sites it was used with, and what device and version this is.
exportHeader.care: Send it only to somebody you mean to tell that.

errors.develop_no_logs: There is nowhere to write a log on this device.
errors.develop_unreadable: The log could not be read.
errors.develop_storage: The log could not be written where you could pick it up.
errors.develop_no_share: There is nothing on this device to hand a file to.
errors.develop_empty: There is nothing in the log to hand over yet.
errors.develop_unknown: That did not work. Try again.

pin.chooseSubtitle: {digits} digits, and this device is the only one that will ever check them.
pin.repeatSubtitle: So a slip does not become a lock nobody can open.
pin.mismatch: Those two do not match. Start again.
pin.currentSubtitle: Asked for first, so nobody who finds the wallet open can replace it.
pin.replaceIntro: The identity itself is untouched. Only the digits that open it change.
pin.armSubtitle: Your PIN, once, and this device is given a key of its own.

attemptsLeft.one: {count} attempt left. When it is gone the identity is removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.
attemptsLeft.other: {count} attempts left. When they are gone the identity is removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.

errors.vault_destroyed: That was the last attempt. The identity has been removed from this device, and your phrase is the way back.
errors.vault_nothing: There is no identity on this device.
errors.vault_exists: This device is already holding an identity.
errors.vault_pin_length: A PIN is four or six digits.
errors.vault_pin_not_digits: A PIN is digits and nothing else.
errors.vault_no_identity: There is no identity open to write down.
errors.vault_no_device_key: This device is not holding a key. Use your PIN.
errors.vault_device_unproven: This device did not recognise you, so nothing has been turned on. Try again, or carry on with your PIN.
errors.vault_no_device_store: This device cannot keep a key of its own, so the PIN is the way in.
errors.vault_unreadable: What is on this device is not something this wallet can read.
errors.vault_too_new: This was written by a newer version of the wallet. Update it, and the identity will be here.
errors.vault_storage: The identity could not be read from this device. Nothing has been changed.
errors.vault_entropy: This device would not supply the randomness the encryption needs. Nothing has been written.
errors.vault_unknown: That did not work. Try again.

problem.title: This device is holding an identity it cannot open
problem.body: Nothing has been lost and nothing has been changed. Until this is answered the wallet will not offer to create a second identity over the one already here.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.intro: Read this before you do. There is no support line that can undo it.
logout.identity: The identity goes. This device is holding it and nothing else is: not the wallet's makers, not the platform, not a backup somewhere.
logout.credentials: Anything issued to it goes with it. A credential belongs to the identity, and an identity nobody can prove is a credential nobody will accept.
logout.phrase: Your phrase is the only way back. With it the identity comes back exactly as it was, on this device or any other. Without it it is gone, and gone is permanent.
logout.question: Do you have your phrase in front of you?
logout.waiting: You can sign out in {seconds} s
